title: Freight Handling and Storage Services
agency_path: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.US EMBASSY ALGIERS
detail_text: SUBJECT: Freight Handling and Storage Services SOLICITATION TYPE : Request for Quotation (RFQ) – sole source This is a pre-solicitation notice for planning purposes only. U.S. Embassy Algiers intends to solicit quotations from Air Algerie Freight Handling and Storage Services. This procurement is being conducted as a sole source acquisition based on a signed Justification for Other Than Full and Open Competition (JOFOC). SERVICE REQUIRED: Air Algerie Freight Handling and Storage Services, including but not limited to Handling the incoming/outgoing shipment deliveries both unclassified/classified for the Mission. Safe and secure storage of Diplomatic Pouch and Mail, DELIVERY LOCATION: 05, Chemin Cheikh Bachir El Ibrahimi, El Biar, Algiers 16030, Algeria. POINT OF CONTACT: Algiers_Procurement@state.gov NOTE: This is not a request for quotations. Do not submit quotes in response to this notice.
